description: This file defines a factory class 'UserRoleManagerFactory' responsible for providing and managing instances of 'AbstractUserRoleManager' related to user roles within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to retrieve, refresh, and update the user role manager instance, coordinating with the 'UserRoleManagerService'.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerFactory
classes.description: A factory class providing access to a singleton or new instances of 'AbstractUserRoleManager' to manage user roles within the system.

methods.name: getUserRoleManager
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of 'AbstractUserRoleManager'. Creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: getNewUserRoleManager
methods.description: Returns a new instance of 'AbstractUserRoleManager', intended for use when session details change.

methods.name: updateUserRoleManager
methods.description: Refreshes the singleton 'userRoleManager' with a new instance, typically after session changes.
